system.description: Once per turn, when you deal lightning damage to a creature, you can spend your Bonus action to release an arc of electricity targeting one creature you can see within 20 feet of the original target, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain the Shocked condition and are marked as a Refraction Point for the next minute.
